representation: Candidate-local immutable rows and hash-pinned references; production event-review spine unchanged. Optional extension proposed only for official model publications.
rules: Future projected values never become what_happened.actuals.
Maintained policy setting must be distinguished from empirical extrapolation.
Sensitivities have shocks, units and horizons, never automatic Scenario/Forecast identity.
Unquantified alternatives remain unquantified; source count is not confidence.
Model comparison requires matching horizons, price bases, methods and original vintages.
Every row/edge/audit finding has an asset plus table/page/chart locator.
Separate human dispositions; schema acceptance is not Analysis admission or publication authority.
production_gap: Native Analysis v0.8 permits empty actuals/benchmarks and DRAFT. It does not validate projection-specific row classes or audits; public_analysis_projection copies entire review objects. Therefore no extension may enter event_reviews until native validation and a public/private allowlist are separately adopted.
limitations: Candidate validation verifies internal structure and pins, not factual correctness or analyst judgement.
Immutable candidate revisions require successor artifacts rather than silent hash refresh.
